preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.source: 农业农村部畜牧兽医局
preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.claim: November 2018 monitored hog inventory was -2.9% YoY and breeding-sow inventory was -6.9% YoY; sow inventory also fell -1.3% MoM.
preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.whyItMatters: Breeding-sow inventory is upstream productive capacity. It can deteriorate months before pork spot prices rise, especially when disease initially accelerates slaughter.

preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.source: 农业农村部/公安部/市场监管总局
preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.claim: Since August, 89 ASF outbreaks had occurred across 22 provinces; controls restricted inter-provincial live-hog transport in affected and adjacent provinces.
preCutoffEvidenceAvailableButMissingFrom.whyItMatters: The disease and transport controls affected both future productive capacity and regional supply chains even while accelerated slaughter temporarily weighed on current prices.

frozenEvidenceConflict.currentFlowSignal: November pork CPI was -1.1% YoY and -0.6% MoM; NBS attributed part of weakness to accelerated slaughter in ASF-affected producing regions.
frozenEvidenceConflict.leadingStateSignal: By Dec 14, monitored breeding-sow inventory was already -6.9% YoY and continuing to fall.
frozenEvidenceConflict.equitySignal: Frozen hog-equity basket had +8.79pp 20d and +26.47pp 60d excess with full breadth.
frozenEvidenceConflict.diagnosis: The frozen process allowed the current spot-price/flow signal to veto the upstream capacity state and broad cross-sectional equity confirmation. That was a causal lead-lag error.

failureClass.name: stock_flow_lead_lag_veto_error
failureClass.description: In slow-replenishment or capacity-constrained systems, a current flow variable such as spot price, revenue or shipment may temporarily move opposite to a deteriorating upstream state variable such as breeding stock, installed capacity, inventory, backlog or qualified supply. Treating the flow signal as a mandatory confirmation can cause the Skill to enter only after the opportunity is already widely priced.

proposedFutureMechanism.name: causal_state_variable_test
requirements: Identify the economically upstream stock/state variable and the downstream flow/price variable separately.
Freeze the causal lag between state deterioration/improvement and downstream earnings.
When state and flow conflict, explain whether the flow can be temporarily distorted by liquidation, destocking, channel filling, backlog burn, accelerated slaughter or similar one-off release.
Require at least one independent state-variable source plus company/value-chain mapping; equity price strength alone is never sufficient.
Use cross-sectional price breadth as corroboration, not as the fundamental proof.
Do not infer the magnitude of the later price move from the state signal; only recognize a directional/convexity opportunity if the earnings bridge and expression quality pass.
proposedFutureMechanism.antiOverfit: Do not add a pork/ASF exception or fixed sow-inventory threshold from this window.

relationshipToOtherFindings.v15BaseHorizonConvexity: Orthogonal. The 2018Q4 miss occurred before promotion: the hypothesis itself was incorrectly fail-closed because the wrong physical variable was treated as the gate.
relationshipToOtherFindings.corporateActionDiscovery: Also orthogonal. 2019Q2 corporate-action blind spot concerns issuer-event discovery, while this failure concerns causal variable selection inside an already-detected macro/industry event.
